body: He started in 1985 with ₹5,000. His early money came from trading, including money borrowed from his brother's clients, and from Tata Tea. By his own account his "biggest wealth" came from being bearish in 1991-92. Titan, bought in 2001-02 when it was out of favour, compounded to about one-third of a portfolio of roughly ₹30,000 crore at his death in August 2022. He called himself a lover of trading and kept trading and investing books separate. Losses (A2Z, Bilcare, the 2008 drawdown) and the 2021 Aptech insider-trading settlement show the other side.
